verses.text: Di Lord visit Sarah as e talk, and di Lord do to Sarah as e promise.
Sarah become pregnant, and born Abraham one pikin man for im old age, for di set time wey God talk to am.
Abraham call im pikin wey dem born to am, wey Sarah born to am, Isaac.
Abraham circumcise im pikin Isaac when e dey eight days old, as God command am.
Abraham dey 100 years old when dem born Isaac im pikin to am.
Sarah talk say, “God don make me laugh. Everyone wey hear go laugh with me.”
E talk say, “Who fit don talk to Abraham say Sarah go breastfeed pikin dem? Because I don born am one pikin man for im old age.”
Di pikin grow, and dem wean am. Abraham make great feast for di day wey Isaac wean.
Sarah see di pikin of Hagar di Egyptian, wey e born to Abraham, dey mock.
Na why e talk to Abraham say, “Drive out dis servant and im pikin, because di pikin of dis servant no go inherit with my pikin, even with Isaac.”
Di thing hard well well for Abraham eyes because of im pikin.
God talk to Abraham say, “Make e no hard for your eyes because of di boy, and because of your servant. For all wey Sarah talk to you, listen to im voice, because for Isaac dem go call your seed.
Di pikin of di servant too I go make nation, because e na your seed.”
Abraham rise early for morning, take bread and one skin of water, give Hagar, put am on im shoulder, and di pikin, and send am away. E go, and wander for di wilderness of Beersheba.
Di water for di skin finish, and e throw di pikin under one of di bushes.
E go sit down opposite am, about one bowshot away, because e talk say, “Make I no see di death of di pikin.” E sit opposite am, lift up im voice, and cry.
God hear di voice of di boy. Di angel of God call Hagar from heaven, talk to am say, “Wetin dey worry you, Hagar? No fear, because God don hear di voice of di boy wia e dey.
Get up, lift di boy up, and hold am for your hand, because I go make am great nation.”
God open im eyes, and e see one well of water. E go, fill di skin with water, and give di boy drink.
God dey with di boy, and e grow. E dwell for di wilderness, and become archer.
E dwell for di wilderness of Paran. Im mama take wife for am from di land of Egypt.
For dat time, Abimelech and Phicol, di captain of im army, talk to Abraham say, “God dey with you for all wey you dey do.

Now therefore swear to me here by God say you no go deal falsely with me, nor with my pikin, nor with my grandpikin. According to di kindness wey I do you, you go do to me, and to di land wia you don stay.”
Abraham talk say, “I go swear.”
Abraham rebuke Abimelech because of one well of water wey Abimelech servants don take by force.
Abimelech talk say, “I no know who do dis thing. You no tell me, and I no hear am until today.”
Abraham take sheep and cattle, give Abimelech, and di two of dem make covenant.
Abraham set seven ewe lambs of di flock by demself.
Abimelech talk to Abraham say, “Wetin dis seven ewe lambs mean, wey you don set by demself?”
E talk say, “You go take dis seven ewe lambs from my hand, so that e go be witness to me, say I dig dis well.”
Na why dem call dat place Beersheba, because di two of dem swear dere.
So dem make covenant for Beersheba. Abimelech rise up, and Phicol di captain of im army, and dem return to di land of di Philistines.
Abraham plant tamarisk tree for Beersheba, and call dere on di name of di Lord, di everlasting God.
Abraham stay as foreigner for di land of di Philistines plenty days.
After dis things, God test Abraham, talk to am say, “Abraham!” E talk say, “Look, I dey here.”
E talk say, “Take now your pikin, your only pikin, wey you love, Isaac, and go to di land of Moriah. Offer am dere as burnt offering on one of di mountains wey I go tell you.”
Abraham rise early for morning, saddle im donkey, and take two of im young men with am, and Isaac im pikin. E cut di wood for di burnt offering, rise up, and go to di place wey God tell am.
For di third day Abraham lift up im eyes, and see di place far away.
Abraham talk to im young men say, “Stay here with di donkey. I and di boy go go over dere. We go worship, and come back to una.”
Abraham take di wood of di burnt offering, put am on Isaac im pikin. E take di fire for im hand, and di knife. Di two of dem go together.
Isaac talk to Abraham im papa say, “My papa?” E talk say, “Here I dey, my pikin.” E talk say, “Look, di fire and di wood, but wia di lamb for di burnt offering dey?”
Abraham talk say, “God go provide for imself di lamb for di burnt offering, my pikin.” So di two of dem go together.
Dem come to di place wey God tell am. Abraham build di altar dere, arrange di wood, bind Isaac im pikin, and lay am on di altar, on top of di wood.
Abraham stretch out im hand, take di knife to kill im pikin.
Di angel of di Lord call am from heaven, talk say, “Abraham, Abraham!” E talk say, “Look, I dey here.”
E talk say, “No lay your hand on di boy, and no do am anything, because now I know say you fear God, seeing say you no hold back your pikin, your only pikin, from me.”
Abraham lift up im eyes, and look, and see one ram behind am, caught for di thicket by im horns. Abraham go take di ram, offer am up for burnt offering instead of im pikin.
Abraham call di name of dat place “Di Lord Go Provide.” Na why dem dey talk till today say, “For di mountain of di Lord, e go dey provided.”
Di angel of di Lord call Abraham from heaven di second time,
talk say, “I don swear by myself,” na so di Lord talk, “because you don do dis thing, and no hold back your pikin, your only pikin,
say I go surely bless you, and I go surely multiply your seed like di stars of di heavens, and like di sand wey dey di seashore. Your seed go possess di gate of im enemies.
For your seed all di nations of di earth go dey blessed, because you don obey my voice.”
So Abraham return to im young men, and dem rise up and go together to Beersheba. Abraham dwell for Beersheba.
After dis things, dem tell Abraham say, “Look, Milcah too don born pikin to your brother Nahor:
Uz im firstborn, Buz im brother, Kemuel di papa of Aram,
Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
Bethuel born Rebekah. Milcah born dis eight to Nahor, Abraham brother.
Im concubine, wey im name na Reumah, born Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah too.
Sarah dey 127 years old. Dis na di years of Sarah life.
Sarah die for Kiriath Arba, wey na Hebron, for di land of Canaan. Abraham come mourn for Sarah, and weep for am.
Abraham rise up from before im dead, talk to di pikin dem of Heth say,
“I na stranger and foreigner with una. Give me possession of one burying place with una, so that I go bury my dead out of my sight.”
Di pikin dem of Heth answer Abraham, talk to am say,
“Hear us, my oga. You na mighty prince among us. Bury your dead for di best of our burial places. None of us go withhold im burial place from you, so that you no go bury your dead.”
Abraham rise up, bow down to di people of di land, to di pikin dem of Heth.
E talk with dem say, “If e dey your mind say I go bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and ask Ephron di pikin of Zohar for me,
so that e go give me di cave of Machpelah, wey e get, wey dey di end of im field. For di full price, make e give am to me for una midst as possession of burying place.”
Now Ephron dey sit among di pikin dem of Heth. Ephron di Hittite answer Abraham for di hearing of di pikin dem of Heth, for all wey go in at di gate of im city, talk say,
“No, my oga, hear me. Di field I give you, and di cave wey dey inside, I give am to you. For di eyes of di pikin dem of my people I give am to you. Bury your dead.”
Abraham bow down before di people of di land.
E talk to Ephron for di hearing of di people of di land, say, “If you go give am, make you hear me. I go give di price of di field. Take am from me, and I go bury my dead dere.”
Ephron answer Abraham, talk to am say,
“My oga, listen to me. Land wey worth 400 shekels of silver, wetin be dat between me and you? Bury your dead.”
Abraham listen to Ephron. Abraham weigh to Ephron di silver wey e talk for di hearing of di pikin dem of Heth, 400 shekels of silver, current money with di merchants.
So di field of Ephron, wey dey Machpelah, wey face Mamre, di field, and di cave wey dey inside, and all di trees wey dey di field, wey dey inside all im borders around, dem make am sure
to Abraham for possession for di eyes of di pikin dem of Heth, before all wey go in at di gate of im city.
After dis, Abraham bury Sarah im wife for di cave of di field of Machpelah before Mamre, wey na Hebron, for di land of Canaan.
Di field, and di cave wey dey inside, dem make am sure to Abraham for possession of burying place by di pikin dem of Heth.
Abraham don old, and e don reach advanced age. Di Lord don bless Abraham for all things.
Abraham talk to im servant, di oldest of im house, wey rule over all wey e get, “Put your hand under my thigh.
I go make you swear by di Lord, di God of heaven and di God of di earth, say you no go take wife for my pikin from di pikin woman dem of di Canaanites, among wey I dey dwell.
But you go go to my country, and to my relatives, and take wife for my pikin Isaac.”
Di servant talk to am say, “Maybe di woman no go willing to follow me to dis land. I must bring your pikin back to di land wey you come from?”
Abraham talk to am say, “Beware say you no bring my pikin back dere again.

Di Lord, di God of heaven, wey take me from my papa house, and from di land of my relatives, wey talk to me, and wey swear to me, say, ‘To your seed I go give dis land,’ e go send im angel before you, and you go take wife for my pikin from dere.
If di woman no willing to follow you, you go dey clear from dis my oath. Only no bring my pikin back dere again.”
Di servant put im hand under di thigh of Abraham im oga, and swear to am concerning dis matter.
Di servant take ten camels, of di camels of im oga, and go; and all di goods of im oga dey im hand. E rise up and go to Mesopotamia, to di city of Nahor.
E make di camels kneel down outside di city by di well of water for evening, di time wey women dey go out to draw water.
E talk say, “Di Lord, di God of my oga Abraham, make you give me success today, and show kindness to my oga Abraham.
Look, I dey stand by di spring of water, and di pikin woman dem of di men of di city dey come out to draw water.

Make am be say di young woman to who I go talk say make e let down im jar so that I go drink, and e go talk say make I drink, and e go give my camels drink too, make na am be di one wey you don appoint for your servant Isaac. By dis I go know say you don show kindness to my oga.”
Before e finish to talk, look, Rebekah come out, wey born to Bethuel, pikin of Milcah, wife of Nahor, Abraham brother, with im jar on im shoulder.
Di girl fine well well to look at, virgin, and no man don know am. E go down to di spring, fill im jar, and come up.
Di servant run to meet am, talk say, “Make I drink small water from your jar.”
E talk say, “Drink, my oga.” E hurry, let down im jar on im hand, and give am drink.
When e don finish to give am drink, e talk say, “I go draw water for your camels too, until dem don finish to drink.”
E hurry, empty im jar into di trough, run again to di well to draw, and draw for all im camels.
Di man dey look am in silence, to know whether di Lord don make im journey prosper or no.
When di camels don finish to drink, di man take one golden ring wey weigh half shekel, and two bracelets for im hands wey weigh ten shekels of gold,
talk say, “Whose pikin you be? Tell me. Room dey for us for your papa house to lodge?”
E talk to am say, “I na di pikin of Bethuel, di pikin of Milcah, wey e born to Nahor.”
E talk to am say, “We get both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge.”
Di man bow im head, and worship di Lord.
E talk say, “Blessed be di Lord, di God of my oga Abraham, wey no leave im lovingkindness and im truth from my oga. As for me, di Lord don lead me for di way to di house of my oga relatives.”
Di girl run, tell dem wey dey im mama house about dis things.
Rebekah get one brother, wey im name na Laban. Laban run out to di man, to di spring.

E come be say when e see di ring, and di bracelets on im sister hands, and when e hear di words of Rebekah im sister, say, “Di man talk to me so,” e come to di man. Look, e dey stand by di camels at di spring.
E talk say, “Come in, you wey di Lord don bless. Why you dey stand outside? Because I don prepare di house, and place for di camels.”
Di man enter di house, and e unload di camels. E give straw and feed to di camels, and water to wash im feet and di feet of di men wey dey with am.
Dem set food before am to eat, but e talk say, “I no go eat until I don talk wetin I come talk.” E talk say, “Talk.”
E talk say, “I na Abraham servant.
Di Lord don bless my oga greatly, and e don become great. E don give am flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
Sarah, my oga wife, born one pikin man to my oga when e don old, and e don give am all wey e get.
My oga make me swear say, ‘You no go take wife for my pikin from di pikin woman dem of di Canaanites, for wey land I dey dwell,
but you go go to my papa house, and to my relatives, and take wife for my pikin.’
I talk to my oga say, ‘Maybe di woman no go follow me.’
E talk to me say, ‘Di Lord, wey I dey waka before, go send im angel with you, and prosper your way. You go take wife for my pikin from my relatives, and from my papa house.
Den you go dey clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If dem no give am to you, you go dey clear from my oath.’
I come today to di spring, and I talk say, ‘Di Lord, di God of my oga Abraham, if now you dey prosper my way wey I dey go,
look, I dey stand by di spring of water. Make am be say di young woman wey go come out to draw, wey I go talk to say make e give me small water from im jar to drink,
and e go talk to me say make I drink, and e go draw for my camels too, make na am be di woman wey di Lord don appoint for my oga pikin.’
Before I finish to talk for my heart, look, Rebekah come out with im jar on im shoulder, and e go down to di spring, and draw. I talk to am say, ‘Make you give me drink.’
E hurry, let down im jar from im shoulder, talk say, ‘Drink, and I go give your camels drink too.’ So I drink, and e give di camels drink too.
I ask am, talk say, ‘Whose pikin you be?’ E talk say, ‘Di pikin of Bethuel, Nahor pikin, wey Milcah born to am.’ I put di ring on im nose, and di bracelets on im hands.
I bow my head, and worship di Lord, and bless di Lord, di God of my oga Abraham, wey don lead me for di right way to take di pikin of my oga relative for im pikin.
Now if una go deal kindly and truly with my oga, tell me; and if no, tell me, so that I go turn to di right hand or to di left.”
Den Laban and Bethuel answer, talk say, “Di thing come from di Lord. We no fit talk to you bad or good.
Look, Rebekah dey before you. Take am, and go, and make am be wife of your oga pikin, as di Lord don talk.”
E come be say when Abraham servant hear dem words, e bow down to di earth to di Lord.
Di servant bring out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and give dem to Rebekah. E give precious things to im brother and to im mama too.
Dem eat and drink, e and di men wey dey with am, and stay di night. Dem rise up for morning, and e talk say, “Send me away to my oga.”
Im brother and im mama talk say, “Make di girl stay with us some days, at least ten. After dat e go go.”
E talk to dem say, “No delay me, seeing say di Lord don prosper my way. Send me away, so that I go go to my oga.”
Dem talk say, “We go call di girl, and ask am.”
Dem call Rebekah, talk to am say, “You go go with dis man?” E talk say, “I go go.”
Dem send Rebekah dem sister away, and im nurse, and Abraham servant and im men.
Dem bless Rebekah, talk to am say, “Our sister, make you become thousands of ten thousands, and make your seed possess di gate of dem wey hate dem.”
Rebekah rise up with im young women, and dem ride on di camels and follow di man. Di servant take Rebekah and go.
Isaac come from di way of Beer Lahai Roi, because e dey dwell for di land of di South.
Isaac go out to meditate for di field for di evening, and e lift up im eyes and see, and look, camels dey come.
Rebekah lift up im eyes, and when e see Isaac, e get down from di camel.
E talk to di servant say, “Who be dis man wey dey waka for di field to meet us?” Di servant talk say, “Na my oga.” Den e take veil, and cover imself.
Di servant tell Isaac all di things wey e don do.
Isaac bring am into im mama Sarah tent, and take Rebekah, and e become im wife. E love am, and Isaac get comfort after im mama death.
Abraham take another wife, wey im name na Keturah.
E born Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
Jokshan born Sheba and Dedan. Di pikin dem of Dedan na Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
Di pikin dem of Midian na Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All dis na di pikin dem of Keturah.
Abraham give all wey e get to Isaac,
but to di pikin dem of Abraham concubines, Abraham give gifts. E send dem away from Isaac im pikin, while e still dey alive, toward di east, to di east country.
Dis na di days of di years of Abraham life wey e live: 175 years.
Abraham die for good old age, old man, and full of years, and e join im people.
Isaac and Ishmael im pikin dem bury am for di cave of Machpelah, for di field of Ephron di pikin of Zohar di Hittite, wey face Mamre,
di field wey Abraham buy from di pikin dem of Heth. For dere dem bury Abraham, and Sarah im wife.
After Abraham death, God bless Isaac im pikin. Isaac dwell by Beer Lahai Roi.
Dis na di generations of Ishmael, Abraham pikin, wey Hagar di Egyptian, Sarah servant, born to Abraham.
Dis na di names of di pikin dem of Ishmael, by dem names, according to dem generations: Nebaioth, di firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
Dis na di pikin dem of Ishmael, and dis na dem names, by dem villages, and by dem encampments: 12 princes according to dem nations.
Dis na di years of Ishmael life: 137 years. E die and join im people.
Dem dwell from Havilah to Shur wey dey before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. E settle for presence of all im brothers.
Dis na di generations of Isaac, Abraham pikin. Abraham born Isaac.
Isaac dey 40 years old when e take Rebekah, di pikin woman of Bethuel di Syrian of Paddan Aram, di sister of Laban di Syrian, to be im wife.
Isaac pray to di Lord for im wife, because e no fit born pikin. Di Lord hear am, and Rebekah im wife become pregnant.
Di pikin dem struggle together inside am. E talk say, “If e be so, why I dey live?” E go ask di Lord.
Di Lord talk to am say, “Two nations dey for your womb. Two peoples go separate from your body. Di one people go dey stronger pass di other people. Di elder go serve di younger.”
When im days to deliver full, look, twins dey im womb.
Di first come out red. All of am dey like hairy garment. Dem call im name Esau.
After dat im brother come out, wey im hand hold Esau heel. Dem call im name Jacob. Isaac dey 60 years old when Rebekah born dem.
Di boys grow. Esau na skillful hunter, man of di field. Jacob na quiet man, dwelling for tents.
Now Isaac love Esau, because e dey eat im venison. Rebekah love Jacob.
Jacob dey cook stew. Esau come in from di field, and e dey tired.
Esau talk to Jacob say, “Make I eat some of dat red stew, because I dey tired.” Na why dem call im name Edom.
Jacob talk say, “Sell me your birthright now.”
Esau talk say, “Look, I dey about to die. Wetin good dis birthright go do me?”
Jacob talk say, “Swear to me now.” E swear to am. E sell im birthright to Jacob.
Jacob give Esau bread and stew of lentils. E eat and drink, rise up, and go im way. So Esau despise im birthright.
Famine dey for di land, besides di first famine wey dey for di days of Abraham. Isaac go to Abimelech king of di Philistines, to Gerar.
Di Lord appear to am, talk say, “No go down to Egypt. Dwell for di land wey I go tell you.
Stay for dis land, and I go dey with you, and go bless you; because to you, and to your seed, I go give all dis lands, and I go establish di oath wey I swear to Abraham your papa.
I go multiply your seed like di stars of heaven, and I go give to your seed all dis lands. For your seed all di nations of di earth go dey blessed,
because Abraham obey my voice, and keep my commandment, my statutes, and my laws.”
Isaac dwell for Gerar.
Di men of di place ask am about im wife. E talk say, “Na my sister,” because e fear to talk say na im wife, say maybe di men of di place go kill am for Rebekah, because e fine to look at.
E come be say, when e don stay dere long time, Abimelech king of di Philistines look out through one window, and see, and look, Isaac dey play with Rebekah im wife.
Abimelech call Isaac, talk say, “Look, surely na your wife. Why you talk say, ‘Na my sister’?” Isaac talk to am say, “Because I talk say, ‘Maybe I go die for im sake.’”
Abimelech talk say, “Wetin be dis wey you don do to us? One of di people fit easily don sleep with your wife, and you for don bring guilt on us.”
Abimelech command all di people, talk say, “Whoever touch dis man or im wife go surely die.”
Isaac sow for dat land, and for dat year e reap 100 times. Di Lord bless am.
Di man grow rich, and e continue to grow until e become very great.
E get possessions of flocks and possessions of herds, and great household, and di Philistines envy am.
Now all di wells wey im papa servants dig for di days of Abraham im papa, di Philistines don stop dem, and fill dem with earth.
Abimelech talk to Isaac say, “Go from us, because you dey much mightier pass us.”
Isaac leave from there, pitch im tent for di valley of Gerar, and dwell there.
Isaac dig again di wells of water wey dem dig for di days of Abraham im papa, because di Philistines don stop dem after Abraham death. E call dem by di names wey im papa call dem.
Isaac servants dig for di valley, and find dere one well of springing water.
Di herdsmen of Gerar quarrel with Isaac herdsmen, talk say, “Di water na ours.” E call di name of di well Esek, because dem quarrel with am.
Dem dig another well, and dem quarrel over am too. E call im name Sitnah.
E move from there, and dig another well. For dat one dem no quarrel. E call im name Rehoboth. E talk say, “Because now di Lord don make room for us, and we go be fruitful for di land.”
E go up from there to Beersheba.
Di Lord appear to am di same night, talk say, “I na di God of Abraham your papa. No fear, because I dey with you, and I go bless you, and multiply your seed for di sake of Abraham my servant.”
E build one altar there, call on di name of di Lord, and pitch im tent there. Isaac servants dig one well there.
Den Abimelech go to am from Gerar, with Ahuzzath im friend, and Phicol di captain of im army.
Isaac talk to dem say, “Why una come to me, seeing say una hate me, and don send me away from una?”
Dem talk say, “We see plainly say di Lord dey with you. We talk say, ‘Make oath dey between us, between us and you, and make we make covenant with you,
say you go do us no harm, as we no touch you, and as we do to you only good, and send you away in peace.’ You na di blessed of di Lord.”
E make feast for dem, and dem eat and drink.
Dem rise early for morning, and swear one to another. Isaac send dem away, and dem leave am in peace.
For dat same day, Isaac servants come, tell am about di well wey dem dig, talk to am say, “We don find water.”
E call am Shibah. Na why di name of di city na Beersheba to dis day.
When Esau dey 40 years old, e take wife, Judith di pikin woman of Beeri di Hittite, and Basemath di pikin woman of Elon di Hittite.
Dem na bitterness of spirit to Isaac and Rebekah.
E come be say when Isaac don old, and im eyes dim so tay e no fit see, e call Esau im older pikin, talk to am say, “My pikin?” E talk to am say, “Look, I dey here.”
E talk say, “Look now, I don old. I no know di day of my death.
Now therefore take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, go out to di field, and hunt venison for me.
Make delicious food for me, such as I love, and bring am to me, so that I go eat, so that my soul go bless you before I die.”
Rebekah dey listen when Isaac talk to Esau im pikin. Esau go to di field to hunt for venison, and to bring am.
Rebekah talk to Jacob im pikin say, “Look, I hear your papa talk to Esau your brother say,
‘Bring me venison, and make delicious food for me, so that I go eat, and bless you before di Lord before I die.’
Now therefore, my pikin, obey my voice according to wetin I command you.
Go now to di flock, and fetch me from dere two good young goats. I go make delicious food of dem for your papa, such as e love.
You go bring am to your papa, so that e go eat, so that e go bless you before e die.”
Jacob talk to Rebekah im mama say, “Look, Esau my brother na hairy man, and I na smooth man.
Maybe my papa go feel me, and I go seem to am as deceiver. I go bring curse on myself, and no blessing.”
Im mama talk to am say, “Make your curse dey on me, my pikin. Only obey my voice, and go fetch dem for me.”
E go, fetch, and bring dem to im mama. Im mama make delicious food, such as im papa love.
Rebekah take di good clothes of Esau, im older pikin, wey dey with am for di house, and put dem on Jacob, im younger pikin.
E put di skins of di young goats on im hands, and on di smooth part of im neck.
E give di delicious food and di bread, wey e don prepare, into di hand of im pikin Jacob.
E go in to im papa, talk say, “My papa?” E talk say, “Look, I dey here. Who you be, my pikin?”
Jacob talk to im papa say, “I na Esau your firstborn. I don do as you talk me. Sit up now and eat of my venison, so that your soul go bless me.”
Isaac talk to im pikin say, “How you find am so quick, my pikin?” E talk say, “Because di Lord your God bring am to me.”
Isaac talk to Jacob say, “Come near, make I feel you, my pikin, whether you na really my pikin Esau or no.”
Jacob go near to Isaac im papa. E feel am, talk say, “Di voice na Jacob voice, but di hands na di hands of Esau.”
E no recognize am, because im hands dey hairy, like im brother Esau hands. So e bless am.
E talk say, “You na really my pikin Esau?” E talk say, “I be.”
E talk say, “Bring am near to me, and I go eat of my pikin venison, so that my soul go bless you.” E bring am near to am, and e eat. E bring am wine, and e drink.
Im papa Isaac talk to am say, “Come near now, and kiss me, my pikin.”
E come near, and kiss am. E smell di smell of im clothing, and bless am, talk say, “Look, di smell of my pikin dey like di smell of field wey di Lord don bless.
God give you of di dew of heaven, of di fatness of di earth, and plenty grain and new wine.
Make peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be oga over your brothers, and make your mama pikin dem bow down to you. Cursed be everyone wey curse you, and blessed be everyone wey bless you.”
E come be say, as soon as Isaac don finish to bless Jacob, and Jacob don just go out from di presence of Isaac im papa, Esau im brother come in from im hunting.
E too make delicious food, and bring am to im papa. E talk to im papa say, “Make my papa arise, and eat of im pikin venison, so that your soul go bless me.”
Isaac im papa talk to am say, “Who you be?” E talk say, “I na your pikin, your firstborn, Esau.”
Isaac tremble very greatly, talk say, “Who then be im wey don hunt venison, and bring am to me, and I don eat of all before you come, and I don bless am? Yes, e go dey blessed.”
When Esau hear di words of im papa, e cry with great and very bitter cry, talk to im papa say, “Bless me, even me also, my papa.”
E talk say, “Your brother come with deceit, and e don take your blessing.”
E talk say, “Dem no rightly call im name Jacob? Because e don cheat me dis two times. E take my birthright. Look, now e don take my blessing.” E talk say, “You no reserve blessing for me?”
Isaac answer Esau say, “Look, I don make am your oga, and all im brothers I don give to am for servants. With grain and new wine I don sustain am. Wetin I go do for you, my pikin?”
Esau talk to im papa say, “You get only one blessing, my papa? Bless me, even me also, my papa.” Esau lift up im voice, and weep.
Isaac im papa answer, talk to am say, “Look, your dwelling go be away from di fatness of di earth, and away from di dew of heaven from above.
By your sword you go live, and you go serve your brother. E go come be say when you break loose, you go shake im yoke from off your neck.”
Esau hate Jacob because of di blessing wey im papa bless am. Esau talk for im heart say, “Di days of mourning for my papa dey near. Den I go kill my brother Jacob.”
Dem tell Rebekah di words of Esau, im older pikin. E send and call Jacob, im younger pikin, talk to am say, “Look, your brother Esau dey comfort imself concerning you by plan to kill you.
Now therefore, my pikin, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban my brother for Haran.
Stay with am some days, until your brother anger turn away,
until your brother anger turn away from you, and e forget wetin you do to am. Den I go send, and bring you from dere. Why I go lose una two for one day?”

Rebekah talk to Isaac say, “I don tire for my life because of di pikin woman dem of Heth. If Jacob take wife of di pikin woman dem of Heth, like dem, of di pikin woman dem of di land, wetin good my life go do me?”
